notes.title: Support The Embroideryvania Kickstarter
notes.notes:
[p]So first off, [i]our bad.[/i] We should have mentioned the Kickstarter sooner. Things are moving fast over here at No Sequels Cooperative, and we're still figuring out how to be in all the places at once!
[/p][p]That being said, let us inyroduce the [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nosequelscooperative/embroideryvania-a-video-game-you-can-byong-to"]Embroideryvania Kickstarter[/url] project! As some of you may know, the final stretch in getting a game ready for the public to play always seems to be the toughest (for a lot of reasons). We've put together this Kickstarter to help get us over the hump, with a ready to play early access version of the game by October 2025, just in time for Steam Next Fest![/p][p][/p][p]The project received the "Projects We Love" seal of approval, and within the first two days is already 50% funded. But we set our goal to the bare minimum of what we would need to get the Early release version onto Steam for all of you to enjoy. But we're No Sequels Cooperative, [i]of course[/i] we have stretch goals and big plans that involve upgrades and DLC and so much more.[/p][p][/p][p]Anyway- we might be 50% funded but we still have a long way to go. Check out the project, share it with your friends, you know the drill. [/p]
